title: Backtraceable follow-up ticket format + re-enabled synthesis
detail: Backtraceable, verifiable follow-up ticket format + re-enabled synthesis in the stop-hook. Gated on ExplicitIngestion signals only (successful live feedback_ingest call + not-helpful/mixed rating) — documented rationale for excluding bare FailedToolCall signals from synthesis. Idempotent dedupe via a deterministic UUIDv5 ticket id derived from session_id+tool_call_id (the id itself is the dedupe key; no separate index needed). Draft description links session/tool-call/event backtrace + cross-reference guidance to the live-persisted FeedbackEntry + a validation-execution reminder.
